claims.text: A 60-second apnea window from recording a01, starting at 2000-01-01T07:25:00+00:00 and ending at 07:26:00+00:00, was flagged as an anomaly by the detector.

The detector classified the window as anomaly with a reconstruction error of 0.3975, exceeding the anomaly threshold of 0.0453, yielding a normalized margin of 7.78; these values are reconstruction threshold evidence and not probabilities or calibrated confidence.

The model is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (version apnea-01-a01_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset with test patient a01; no signal-level or attention-level evidence was available for this window.
The current event is supported by detector evidence indicating an anomaly, but signal and attention explanations are unavailable, and no longitudinal or clinical context was supplied.
